title: Harbor Cafe renewal prep (hard: pronouns and relative dates)

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay, it's the seventeenth today, Wednesday. Let's go through the Harbor Cafe renewal. Sofia, you know the account best.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Yeah. So, um, they want to renew. They said it on the call yesterday. But they want a longer term, three years instead of one, in return for a better rate.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Three years. Hm. Marcus, any engineering reason not to?

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: No, the portal doesn't care. It's a contract thing.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Priya?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: From supply, three years is fine. Kessler gave us volume pricing anyway.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Then I'm in favour. Anyone against? No? Okay, three-year renewal, decided.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Great, they'll be happy.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Do they know about the migration?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Not yet. Um, that's a problem, because the migration slips by a week.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Right. The delay. Is anyone going to tell them, who is going to tell Harbor Cafe about the delay? Because it should not come as a surprise.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: I don't want to be the one to say it on the same call as the renewal.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: It's not a supply thing.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Technically it's mine, but I don't speak to customers.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay. Leave that. Who has the contract?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Right, so the contract. Lena in legal wants it by next week. Sofia has the draft, I mean I have the draft. It's on my laptop. And Tom said the legal office needs a day.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay. Which day next week?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: A week from tomorrow, that gives them time before the board meeting.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: A week from tomorrow, so, tomorrow is the eighteenth, a week after that is the twenty-fifth. Okay.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Yes, the twenty-fifth.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: And who is sending it?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Priya, can you send it? You have Lena's email.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Oh, I thought Sofia would, since she has the draft. I just forwarded Lena an email last week.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Priya, are you sending it or not?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: No, I think Sofia is. She'll send it to legal, it's her draft. I'll just give her the address.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Fine. Okay. I'll send the contract to legal then, for the twenty-fifth.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Good. Now the migration risks. Marcus.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: So, um, the plan is, we do it on a Tuesday night. If something goes wrong with the invoices, he, that is I, would roll back from the snapshot. It's a ten minute job, but you have to know the commands.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: And that is you.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Yes. If it fails, I'll handle the rollback. I won't be on holiday. Nobody else knows the commands.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay. Noted. Sofia, did you say something about the site visit?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Yeah, I think we should go see the main cafe, show the new portal, and, I could probably book that. It depends on the cafe manager, I'd have to check her calendar.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Try to arrange it if you can.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: I'll try to book the site visit. Um, no date, it depends.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Fine.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Do we have the board pack? The board meets on the thirtieth.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: It's the thirtieth, a Tuesday. And the pack should go out the day after the board meeting?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: No, before. The day before. I mean the directors want it the day before. So that is, um, the twenty-ninth.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Hm. Hold on. It's not the thirtieth. The board is on the thirtieth, the pack goes out the day after for the minutes. The pre-read goes before.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Oh. The post-meeting pack. Right. That's what I was thinking. So the pack to the directors goes out the day after the board meeting, July first.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Yes. The first of July. And you'll send it, Priya?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Yes. She, um, I mean I'll send the board pack to the directors on July first.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Good.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Sorry, I am confused, who sends what?

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Priya sends the board pack, Sofia sends the contract.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: And I'll prepare the renewal pricing sheet. I need that by two weeks from Friday, because that's when we sign.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Two weeks from Friday. So Friday is the nineteenth, plus two weeks.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: The third of July. Yes.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Perfect.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Anyone want coffee? I'm going down.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Oat flat white please.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Just water for me, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Does anyone have the Harbor logo for the deck?

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Check the shared drive. There is a folder.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Found it.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay, thank you everyone. I think we're done.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Thanks.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Bye.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Bye.

decisions.text: Harbor Cafe renewal moves to a three-year term
